text.tspan: Same six phases. Completely different rhythm.
WATERFALL — one pass, all the way down
Months long. Going back upstream is expensive,
so the plan is made once, early. Users do not see
working software until the very end.
AGILE — the same cycle, over and over
Every sprint produces something that works and
can be shown. Feedback arrives while there is still
time and budget to act on it.
Neither one is "correct". Waterfall suits work where change is genuinely rare and expensive; Agile suits work where it is not.
